keywords_en: unit mismatch in EIP-7002 withdrawal transactions
summary_en: A quiet weekend. While verifying an EIP-7002 withdrawal or exit transaction, pcaversaccio was reminded of a unit mismatch inside it. On ethresear.ch a team proposed SI-RVP, moving optimistic rollup dispute bisection offchain and replacing onchain MIPS leaf execution with a single instruction Groth16 proof. fede_intern said Lean Ethereum is moving forward.
